beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The line plot records measurements. Length measures end to end. Each feather was measured once, to the nearest centimeter. C M means centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Each cross records one feather's length. This four centimeter feather has a mark above four. The numbers are equally spaced.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Find how many measured four centimeters.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The number below is four, so I count four here.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count the marks: one, two, three. Each is one feather.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Three feathers, each four centimeters long.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The number below tells length; the stack tells how many. At five centimeters, no feathers. At eight centimeters, two feathers.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: For longer than four centimeters, look right. Exactly four is not longer, so those marks stay outside.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: There are none at five, one at six, one at seven, and two at eight. One plus one plus two makes four feathers.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: For how many in all, count once: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight. Each feather contributed one mark.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The shortest is three centimeters; the longest is eight. Two and nine have no feathers.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Align their quill ends. The difference is how much longer one is. Count the extra centimeter spaces: one, two, three, four, five.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Eight minus three is five centimeters, the extra length.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: These same five spaces fit from three to eight on the plot. The answer measures length, in centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: At four centimeters, there are three feathers.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Longer than four centimeters, there are four feathers.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: In all: eight feathers, counting every mark once.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The difference is longest minus shortest: eight minus three equals five centimeters.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Count marks for how many. Compare lengths for how much longer.
